description: tangent-hole's operands fused rather than cut, at the contact and with the hole a tolerance (1e-7) out through the side face: the cylinder's wall touches the face x = 0 along a ruling inside the plate, and its section with the top face is a circle tangent to the top face's edge at one point. Arris fails at both: an edge used by one coedge (Fault::Builder, EdgeUses); the common fails the same. The desired result is the tangent contact's refusal by name, as for the cut: the top face would keep a section curve tangent to its own edge at a vertex (Reason::TangentContact). Open CASCADE builds a shell of odd Euler characteristic, as for tangent-hole (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
